names.note: Name page 14299 of days.pravoslavie.ru is «Алексий (Красновский), иерей, сщмч.»; the grade and the rank are stripped and the surname kept, the day line itself giving only «Алексия пресвитера». `fk.mjs` on the stored string returns NONE; the corpus holds `hippolytus-krasnovsky` and `vladimir-krasnovsky`, two other forenames on other days.

death.note: The day line closes «(1938)», one year for both men of the entry; no year of birth anywhere.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 29 июля ст. ст. — «Сщмч. Алексия пресвитера, прмч. Пахомия (1938).»

attestations.note: The first man of the day's twelfth and last entry, a joint line which grades its two men differently: «Сщмч.» for him and «прмч.» for the other. The line says «пресвитера» and name page 14299 «иерей», priest, which agree, so `presbyter` and the office `Priest` are both the source's own words. `new-martyr` is written as this corpus writes it for this calendar's twentieth-century «сщмч.» entries, and THE 26 ЯНВАРЯ SYNAXIS PAGE WAS NOT OPENED. The entry carries a link to the reading life4747, which is the SAME reading the day's tenth entry links, and it was NOT opened for either. No folder held him: `ls -d saints/*krasnovsky*` returns two other forenames. The day page prints no hymn under his name.
